technology_name: A DIABETIC-FRIENDLY TAPIOCA-BASED EDIBLE CUTLERY AND A METHOD FOR MAKING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard disposable catering utensils accumulate indefinitely in municipal landfill networks, while existing wheat-based edible cutleries trigger glycemic spikes unsuitable for diabetic cohorts.
description: A structural food manufacturing process creating robust, water-resistant edible cutlery items molded strictly from low-starch raw cassava tubers and an organic cross-linked protective starch coating matrix.
applications: Eco-friendly catering utensil lines, diabetic-friendly consumer tableware brands, high-strength zero-waste storage materials, and zero-plastic hospitality supplies.
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Water, Environment & Waste Management
